subject: Administrative Appeal for Keeping Residential Chickens
overview: The board elected a new chair and heard several zoning cases, including a contested administrative appeal regarding city livestock regulations. The board approved residential variances and a special permit for a local business expansion while upholding a zoning violation against the keeping of chickens.

items.title: Election of Chair
items.summary: Elected Andre Leroux as the new chair of the board.

items.title: 85 Elm Street Variance Extension
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension for variances at 85 Elm Street due to delays in stormwater testing.

items.title: 7 Tyrell Road Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a side porch awning that encroaches on the required side yard setback.

items.title: 33 Watson Street Administrative Appeal
items.summary: Upheld the Building Commissioner's violation notice regarding the keeping of chickens as an illegal livestock use after a motion to overturn the determination failed to reach a supermajority. The board debated whether chickens should be classified as pets or livestock in the absence of a specific ordinance definition.

items.title: 145 Jerome Street Lot-Width Variance
items.summary: Approved a lot-width variance for a new two-family dwelling, conditioned on the demolition of an adjacent structure and the recording of a land transfer to meet lot area requirements.

items.title: 42 Dexter Street Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a change of non-conforming use to convert a former auto-repair garage into an engineering and prototyping office.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the board minutes from meetings held in January and February 2026.
